questions.q: Which of the following is a standard statutory requirement for a public limited company seeking a formal listing on the main board of the Stock Exchange?
options: A total exemption from paying corporate income taxes for a minimum of ten years
Submission of audited financial statements covering a specified continuous operating period (typically 3 to 5 years)
A guarantee that at least $90\%$ of all company equity remains in the private possession of executive directors
Registration and operation strictly as a not-for-profit non-governmental organization (NGO)
questions.explain:
To obtain listing on the main board of a stock exchange, a company must satisfy strict regulatory listing requirements, including:
1. Being incorporated as a Public Limited Company (Plc).
2. Providing **audited financial statements** showing a verifiable track record of operations and profitability for 3 to 5 consecutive years.
3. Making a specified minimum proportion of its equity (the public float) available to the general investing public.
